senses.gloss:
कौमार कौमार, i. e. कुमार + अ,
 I. adj., f. री,
 1. Referring to abstinence, MBh. 3, 8527.
 2. Married as virgin (κουριδίη), Rām. 2, 30, 8.
 3. Referring to the god of war, MBh. 3, 4086.
 II. f. री, The energy of the god of war, one of the seven mothers, Dev. 8, 16.
 III. n.
 1. Childhood, Man. 9, 3.
 2. Chastity, MBh. 13, 5853.
कौमारक कौमार + क, n. Childhood, Mārk. P. 11, 20.
कौमारराज्य कौमारराज्य, i. e. कुमार-राजन् + य, n. Condition of a prince royal, Rām. 2, 58, 20.
कौमारिक कौमारिक, i. e. कुमारी + इक, m. The father of daughters, MBh. 1, 4054.

कौमुद कौमुद, i. e. कुमुद + अ,
 I. m. The month Kārttika, Oct.--Nov., MBh. 13, 3370.
 II. f. दी,
 1. Moonlight, Bhartṛ. 1, 38.
 2. The day of full moon in the month Kārttika, MBh. 13, 6132.
कौमोदकी कौमोदकी, i. e. कु-मोदक + ई, f. The club of Viṣṇu, or Kṛṣṇa, MBh. 1, 8200.
